_schema.description: BLDC motor catalog for use with COMPAct-style actuator decomposition. Each entry is a single motor — gearboxes are added at runtime to form an Actuator. Add custom motors by appending to the `motors` array. Entries are ordered by increasing motor-side torque density (Kt*Imax / mass, N*m/kg). `index` is a GLOBAL index shared with catalogs/actuators.json's `index` field -- the two files together form one combined motor+actuator torque-density ranking (motors always land at the low end since they're pre-gearbox), see catalogs/README.md for the merged table.

units.index: [-] (0-based position in the COMBINED motors.json+actuators.json torque-density ranking -- not read by actuator.py's loader, purely for readability/cross-referencing with README.md)
